verdict.rationale: First-party DGX B200 docs specify an 8x B200 system with 1,440 GB GPU memory and two 5th-gen NVLink switches providing 14.4 TB/s aggregate bandwidth. They also cover BlueField-3 DPUs and cluster- and data-center-level management, and NVIDIA offers DGX SuperPOD as turnkey data-center infrastructure. Community reports on HGX B200 confirm NVLink/NVSwitch operating in practice via Fabric Manager partitioning. Missing for 10: detailed rack-scale/SuperPOD deployment documentation beyond marketing copy, inter-node networking specs, and independent corroboration of multi-node training/serving at scale.
